description: mightymodels: export the plugin data directory to the session's commands, so `mightymodels verify run` opens the database the state server keeps; deny a dispatch by one of this plugin's workers (agent_type mightymodels:<folder>:<worker>) outside the workers its agent file allows, and a dispatch of the engineer or the architect by any other caller, the main thread included, while the one unclosed ticket on the checked-out branch has no task in progress or the state cannot be read; keep a scout's report for search, from its hand-back or else its closing text; hold an implementer's stop once while its task has no DONE brief; and write the snapshot of the ticket on the checked-out branch before a compaction. Every entry is cancelled after 10 seconds, and the dispatch wrapper stops its own command after 8 so that a stalled check still refuses.
